scope: Public first-party model, system-card, paper, and official benchmark evidence. Search/research benchmarks are separated from browser-interaction benchmarks.

organizations.notes: GPT-6 Astra publishes computer-use scores and a Mind2Web latency comparison, but no WebArena-Verified score on its launch page.
The Claude Sonnet 4.6 system card documents official WebArena-Verified prompt/grader use and Average@5 reporting.
Gemini 2.5 Computer Use reports both official-leaderboard and Browserbase-harness Online-Mind2Web results, illustrating harness sensitivity.
AutoWebGLM publishes adapters/evaluation assets, but modifies WebArena for its interaction system, so numbers are not automatically comparable with an unmodified harness.
The inspected official Kimi releases emphasize search/research benchmarks; no first-party browser-interaction evaluation was found in this audit. Do not count BrowseComp as UI browser use.
No first-party browser-interaction benchmark disclosure was found in the inspected official model materials. Absence of public evidence is not evidence of no internal evaluation.

The main product README highlights the open 100-task BU Bench and an Odysseys leaderboard result. The benchmark repository currently puts Stealth Bench V1 first, but that measures anti-bot browser infrastructure rather than end-to-end agent task completion. BU Bench, Online-Mind2Web, and Odysseys all use model-based judging in their documented workflows.

benchmark_families.warning: Original Mind2Web, Online-Mind2Web, and Mind2Web 2 have different tasks and graders and must not share a score table.
